transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hi, I want to apply for a business loan.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great! How long has your business been operating, in months?

transcript.speaker: agent

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for that! Where is your business located in the U.S.?

transcript.speaker: agent
